periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis is oriented vertically with a slight lateral divergence at the superior end relative to the facial midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid morphology; the vertical height is approximately twice the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering of the patch, with the lowest point being significantly narrower than the superior portion.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, occupying approximately 35% of the visible lateral torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide cranial separation; the distance between ears is roughly 1.5 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, semi-circular curvature at the superior boundaries with no visible flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellowish-brown pigmentation/staining present in the fur of the lower abdominal and inguinal regions.
